name: 家用安装全能充电电钻款
description: 一机搞定全屋安装、多档电池可选、无级变速省力安全

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal #26282C sections and pure white #FFFFFF sections, one neutral mid-grey #6A6D72 feature panel, rounded white info cards on dark, small golden-yellow divider bars
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral directional studio key at 5600K from the upper left, controlled metal speculars, soft contact shadows; dark sections with gentle falloff, light sections bright and even
styleLock.surfaceSystem: brushed-graphite step podiums and wall panels; warm wood floors and bright home interiors inside scene photos; matte white tiles for application grids
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; silver-white #D9DBDE headlines on dark sections, charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on light sections with grey sublines and short golden-yellow #F2A93B divider bars
styleLock.iconSystem: metallic-silver filled feature icons on the grey panel, small orange #ED7B2E annotation dots with thin leader lines, rounded rectangle label pills; consistent across the set
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; battery foot always grounded with contact shadow; no floating product; annotations never cover the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial home-improvement power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #26282C, pure white #FFFFFF, neutral mid-grey panel #6A6D72 and one golden-yellow accent #F2A93B, with one cool blue #3FA9F5 reserved exclusively for the motor energy-beam graphic; neutral directional studio lighting at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines, silver-white #D9DBDE headlines on dark sections and charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on light sections with short golden-yellow divider bars; consistent metallic-silver filled feature icons, small orange #ED7B2E annotation dots with thin leader lines and rounded rectangle label pills; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale, battery foot always grounded; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins inside info panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 低角度台阶承托立式整机，金属大标题一秒传递强劲动力，赢取点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front angle from a low eye level looking slightly upward, full product standing upright on stacked step podiums, nothing clipped
shots.lighting: neutral directional key from the upper left at 5600K, controlled speculars on the metal chuck, soft contact shadow under the battery
shots.background: deep charcoal #26282C with vertical brushed-graphite wall panels
shots.textZone: top center two-line metallic-silver headline, right column three icon-and-label items, top-right corner a small golden-yellow bar accent
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Power hero: {product} standing upright on stacked brushed-graphite step podiums, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle from a low eye level looking slightly upward, full product visible, battery foot firmly grounded. Neutral directional key light from the upper left at 5600K, controlled specular highlights on the metal chuck, soft contact shadow under the battery. Deep charcoal #26282C background with vertical brushed-graphite wall panels. Product occupies 35-40% of the frame, placed left of center, with the charcoal field kept clean around the text zones so the layout reads as one complete balanced hero. Text zone: top center a two-line metallic-silver #D9DBDE headline 「{callout_1}」 with one small golden-yellow #F2A93B lightning accent, right column three icon-and-label items 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in white, top-right corner a small vertical golden-yellow #F2A93B bar accent completing the corner. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos or readable brand text, no watermark, no garbled characters, no extra props, no hands, no cut-off product, no fake certification marks, no floating product without contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 11 张切片（800×1200，60px 重叠）拼合提炼。源文件夹为『五金』、文件名『大功率电钻』，图中实际产品为黄黑配色家用充电式锂电钻（多功能充电手电钻），与文件名相符；按 taxonomy 归入 家装灯具/五金工具。已剥离：右上角花形 logo、QIANTU/千图水印与页眉、会员二维码角标、乱码英文文案、『德国品质』等不可验证宣称及 12V/16V/24V、续航分钟数等无法核实数值（一律不呈现具体数字，相关位置以卖点与使用场景文案表达）。注意：源参数卡所用产品渲染图为灰橙配色，与主图黄黑整机不一致，升级后按套内统一黄黑渲染。定位为家用安装多能充电钻，与库内『大功率锂电冲击手电钻』『无刷一机多用冲击锂电钻』两份模版在定位、卖点与 id 上可区分。
